blind_spots.note: Attribution stops at the assembled text: the plugin can prove a fusion happened but cannot prove whether the relay or the adapter assigned one index to two calls.

Closed 2026-11-09: P-0001 was verified on a real headless DSH profile (remedy-live, dsh 0.2.2-rc.1). Evidence: data/results/live-2026-11-09T17-00-00.000Z.json. The desktop profile was not restarted; that remains the next mount.
The plugin journal is off by default. A repair that happens in a session with no journal leaves only the session log as evidence.
Synthetic ids are deterministic per call but not stable across replays; they are traceability aids, not durable identities.
The message fallback parses `Received arguments:` from the adapter's English failure text. A localized host message would disable that fallback; the delta buffer path still works.
A max-tokens truncation is never repaired: the tail is missing, and inventing it would dispatch a call the model did not make.

The live headless profile does not persist assistant/attempt streams, so the artifact's session.fused_calls is 0 even on a repaired turn. The repair is evidenced by the journal counters and the synthetic tool-call id; a profile that logs attempts would make the two agree.

Closed 2026-11-09: dsh-remedy was mounted on the desktop profile, the app was restarted, and the desktop process repaired 2 fused calls across 39 streams (data/results/live-desktop-2026-11-09T19-10-00.000Z.json). The tarball sha256 is still what the evidence covers.

The desktop journal covers the whole app process, so its 2 repaired calls span two sessions while the attached session file shows 1. The artifact records journal_scope explicitly; a per-session journal would make the two agree.

Registry copies lag the publish call by seconds. publish-2026-11-10T00-10-00.000Z.json is red because it was recorded at 06:35:37Z and the 0.1.1 copy appeared at 06:35:35Z in the packument but not in the view used by the check. Red publish artifacts are kept and a new stamp records the settled state.

A split-out call is emitted as a block-start plus a block-end on a fresh index. The live run of 2026-11-10 (data/results/live-2026-11-10T14-45-00.000Z.json) proves the finish-path sequence is accepted: the synthetic id call_00_6zgcmtvebmpnr8613wbr7wk9#remedy-1 was dispatched as a read call and answered. What stays open is narrower: the measured adapter never closes tool-call blocks itself, so an adapter with its own index bookkeeping that relies on opened blocks is still unmeasured.

Closed 2026-11-10 by P-0003, and verified live the same day: recordRejected no longer increments fused for every rejection. A refusal that never proved a fusion moves refused only (so a stream whose only defect is bad JSON reads quiet), a withdrawal moves withdrawn, and unrepaired now means exactly one thing: a proven fusion that was not repaired. The live budget-refusal run (data/results/live-2026-11-10T16-30-00.000Z.json) wrote fused:1 refused:1 unrepaired:1 and verdict degraded with turn_end=error — it declined to repair and said so instead of claiming a repair. What stays open is narrower and recorded in the patch doc: the four verdict states are unchanged, so a state name still cannot say 'observed, refused, and correctly not repaired' (only the counter row can), old journal lines keep the six-field counter shape because no migration rewrites them, and a live stream that moves withdrawn is still unmeasured.

The gate set does not cover packages/*/README.md. gate_copy only verifies the eleven outward files at the repository root, and packages/plugin/README.md is hand-written package prose with no recorded output_sha256, so nothing compared it with the binary until P-0010 added tests/unit/cli-usage.test.ts — and that test compares only the `scan` usage line, not the rest of the page. Closing it means either moving the package README into the copy channel (so it is generated and hashed) or adding a test that every command shape it mentions exists in the USAGE text.

The `withdrawn` bucket cannot move on this host, and that is now measured rather than assumed. `rolled-back` needs a proven repair held in `pending`, and `pending` is only filled by the `block-end` path; fused text here arrives in `tool-call-chunks` entries, which are repaired at `finish` and never held. The probe `scripts/probe_withdrawn_reachability.mjs` walked 24 329 persisted attempt streams: 62 carry a fused `tool-call-chunks` entry, 23 724 carry arguments inside a `block-end`, and **0** carry a provable fusion inside a `block-end` (artifact `data/results/withdrawn-reachability-2026-11-12T09-40-00.000Z.json`). So a live `withdrawn` can only come from `consumer-abort`, which needs a consumer that stops reading mid-stream — not something a scripted headless run does. P-0003 therefore stays verified for the branch that was observed (budget refusal) and its `withdrawn` half stays unit-proven by design, not by lack of effort.
